title: Intervention anchors and scientific verification in synthetic vascular predictive representations
abstract: arXiv:2610.11704v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Complete orthogonal predictive coordinates do not by themselves bind a latent direction to a named intervention. We present a mathematical and synthetic audit motivated by vascular device-vessel suitcordance. Capacity-matched least-squares predictors were exactly equivalent under complete fixed output transforms, whereas an anchor-only observer recovered interpretations only within the span of known perturbation signatures. Six three-dimensional configurations across 64 seeds gave a maximum paired prediction discrepancy of 6.7e-15 but a median untransported edit error of 1.513. Coordinate transport removed that error. Noisy and weak anchors constrained calibration stability, and changing the representation basis required recalibration or verified transport. Across 256 additional fits in dimensions 3-24, prediction equivalence persisted within 4.0e-15. We then evaluated nine deliberate runnable fault classes across 64 seeds. All 576 fault

translated_title: 合成血管预测表征中的干预锚点与科学验证
translated_abstract: 完整的正交预测坐标本身并不能将潜在方向绑定到具名的干预上。我们提出了一项受血管装置-血管适配一致性启发的数学与合成审计。在完全固定的输出变换下，容量匹配的最小二乘预测器完全等价，而仅依赖锚点的观察者只能在已知扰动签名所张成的空间内恢复解释。在64个随机种子下的六种三维配置中，最大配对预测差异为6.7e-15，但未迁移编辑误差的中位数为1.513。坐标迁移消除了该误差。噪声大且弱的锚点限制了校准的稳定性，改变表征基需要重新校准或经过验证的迁移。在3至24维的额外256次拟合中，预测等价性保持在4.0e-15以内。随后，我们在64个种子下评估了九类刻意设计的可运行故障。全部576个故障（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 完整的正交预测坐标本身无法将潜在方向绑定到具体的干预上，必须借助干预锚点或经过验证的坐标迁移才能实现可解释性与科学验证。
en_tdlr: Complete orthogonal predictive coordinates alone cannot bind latent directions to named interventions; intervention anchors or verified coordinate transport are required to achieve interpretability and scientific verification.
